contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin. Penny of Edward the Martyr (975-978), Lincoln mint issue of the moneyer Grind, as kindly identified from photographs by Peter Spencer, at the behest of the finder. Peter describes this coin as 'very rare'. Obverse description: Diademed and draped bust left. Initial cross pattee. Obverse inscription: +AEDVV[A]RD [?REX].ANGL. Reverse description: Small central cross pattee. Reverse…
